etf_leg.limit_source: computed per section 8.3 (preclose x (1 +/- band), 0.001 tick)
etf_leg.routing: section 8.2: ETF pm decisions live next pm; ETF fallbacks execute at pm opens

stats.contract: v1 (docs/plans/p3-band-contract.md section 7) + v1.1 engine-side intent layer (prereg section 9 revision 2)

fees.transfer_fee: not modelled (~0.1bp/leg SSE only; standing disclosure)

k3_fallback.pnl_definition: net market-exit proceeds minus shares * previous official close
k3_fallback.definition: risk-intent sells unfilled for 3 consecutive live sessions are market-exited at the next session open (opening limit-down / suspension / T+1-lock defer)

caps.definition: section 7.3 (section 7.7 M2): single-name MV <= 25% of the decision-point equity snapshot, validated at order construction (breach -> whole order voids); drift breaches are recorded only (no force trim); the total<=100% cap is implied by full funding and never fires on an affordable order

definitions.fill_rate_order_session: filled orders / orders (every order lives exactly one session)
definitions.unfilled_exit_share_buys: buy orders never filled / buy orders
definitions.k3_pnl_contribution: net market-exit proceeds minus shares * previous official close
definitions.caps: section 7.3 limits enforced at fill evaluation against last completed day's official-close marks (conservative, no intraday look-ahead)
